 Love the 90s Gran Canaria today: Haddaway, Safri Duo and DJ Sash!, doors at 18:00 and tickets from €43
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Clara Belmonte 
 14 Nov 2026, 09:30 
 A 4-minute read 
 Stefan Rittershaus / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Haddaway, Safri Duo and DJ Sash! headline Love the 90s Gran Canaria this Saturday, 14 November , on an eleven-act line-up hosted by Fernandisco. 
 Doors open at 18:00 and the show runs from 19:30 to 01:00 , with no set times published for individual artists and no re-entry. 
 Official sales are still open, with general admission at €43 , fees included, although tickets are already shown as sold out on Tomaticket. 
 There is no festival parking at the Anexo del Estadio de Gran Canaria , entry is over-18s only and everything is paid for with the cashless wristband. 
 Haddaway, Safri Duo and DJ Sash! bring songs that were all over commercial radio thirty years ago to Las Palmas de Gran Canaria this evening. Love the 90s Gran Canaria takes place today, Saturday 14 November , at the Anexo del Estadio de Gran Canaria , and anyone who still needs a ticket can buy one through the official sales channel.
 Love the 90s Gran Canaria line-up: Haddaway, Safri Duo and DJ Sash!
 The official line-up brings together Haddaway, Safri Duo, DJ Sash!, Alexia, Rozalla, King África, Mystic, Ann Lee, Jumper Brothers, Viceversa and Sensity World . The night is hosted by Fernandisco , a veteran music radio presenter and DJ.
 This is a line-up of choruses more than names. Haddaway is the ‘What Is Love’ (1993) man; Rozalla is behind ‘Everybody's Free’ (1991); Sash! gave us ‘Ecuador’ (1997), and Ann Lee ‘2 Times’ (1999). Safri Duo and King África stretch the timeline to 2000, with ‘Played-A-Live’ and ‘Bomba’. Alexia covers the Italian eurodance quota. With eleven acts across five and a half hours of show, each set will be short and geared more towards the hits than a full repertoire.
 Official Love the 90s Gran Canaria poster. Image: Sharemusic Times: doors at 18:00 and finish around 01:00
 The organisers have given approximate times: doors open at 18:00 , the show starts at 19:30 and it finishes at 01:00 . They have not published when each artist is on, so anyone going for a particular act will need to be inside from the start or follow the festival's social media during the evening.
 You can arrive late: entry remains open until 60 minutes before the end . What is not allowed is leaving and coming back in. Only in the case of medical need, such as having to take medication that cannot be carried on you, should you let a member of the organising team know.
 Tickets for today: from €43 through official sales
 The official Love the 90s Gran Canaria ticket sales , run by Enterticket, were still open this morning at these final prices, booking fees included:
 General: €43, with access to the general area.
 Front Stage: €89, with a dedicated entry lane, front area, exclusive bar and toilets, and a souvenir pass.
 Standing VIP: €111, with a dedicated lane, VIP area, welcome drink, pre-show nibbles, exclusive bar and toilets, and a pass.
 Pack of five general admission tickets: €175, in other words five for the price of four. In the shop, the fees for this pack are shown separately.
 Reduced mobility: €43, with access to the reduced-mobility area on presentation of a certificate or for wheelchair users, and a single companion who also needs this ticket.
 On Tomaticket , which was also selling the event, tickets are listed as sold out. The organisers recommend buying only through their official channels and warn that they are not responsible for entry problems with tickets bought elsewhere. Tickets can be shown on your phone, and if you are going as a group it is best for each person to carry their own.
 Getting to the Anexo del Estadio and what you can bring
 The venue is on calle Fondos de Segura, s/n , next to the Estadio de Gran Canaria, in Las Palmas. There is no parking for the festival, and the organisers recommend going by public transport, taxi or a chauffeur-driven vehicle. With the finish expected around one in the morning, it is worth planning your journey home.
 Cash is not accepted inside: each ticket comes with a cashless wristband , which can be topped up with cash or card at the venue itself, online or using the QR code at the bars. Any remaining balance, except promotional credit, can be refunded via the official website from 18 November to 17 December , free of charge, using the wristband code. There are food trucks with vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options.
 Before leaving home, it is worth going over the entry rules:
 Over-18s only. 
 You can bring in a 50 cl plastic water bottle without its cap , and there are water fountains inside. Alcoholic drinks, cans and glass are not allowed.
 Also not permitted are power banks , professional cameras, tablets, rigid umbrellas, selfie sticks, aerosols and large rucksacks.
 Love the 90s also has editions in other cities: the Madrid edition already has a date, 29 May 2027 at the Caja Mágica , and our listings also include Barcelona , Sevilla and Valencia . Next month's plans are in our guide to December festivals .
 Sources: official Love the 90s Gran Canaria website (line-up, tickets and FAQs), Enterticket sales and Tomaticket page, consulted on 14 November 2026.
